method.scoreStatus: Indice annuale dei risultati economici nel periodo; ogni governo ha una scheda, mentre il numero richiede almeno un intervallo annuale osservabile
method.missingDataRule: No score when any mandatory indicator, peer or same-duration comparison window is missing
method.endpointRule: Semestral approximation for annual data: for the starting endpoint use the prior year when the published start boundary is in January-June and the start year when it is in July-December; for the final endpoint use the prior year when the published end boundary is in January-June and the end year when it is in July-December. This minimizes, but cannot eliminate, months belonging to another government and does not provide daily precision. startDate and endDate are institutional boundaries published by the Presidency and Camera, not individual resignation dates and not evidence of causal responsibility.
method.attributionRule: The score describes outcomes over annual endpoints and never estimates the causal effect of a government; attribution is always reported separately
